_comment: State bucket is trevaka-<env>-terraform for tampere and <muni>-evaka-<env>-terraform for the others: the same bucket that holds that environment's base.tfstate. plan pins the deployed component versions through versions.auto.tfvars, as CI's 'current' mode does, so it shows drift rather than a version change.
init: ENV=${TFMUX_WORKSPACE##*-}; MUNI=${TFMUX_WORKSPACE%-*}; case $MUNI in tampere) BUCKET=trevaka-$ENV-terraform;; *) BUCKET=$MUNI-evaka-$ENV-terraform;; esac; AWS_PROFILE=trevaka-$ENV terraform init -reconfigure -backend-config=bucket=$BUCKET -backend-config=region=eu-west-1
plan: ENV=${TFMUX_WORKSPACE##*-}; MUNI=${TFMUX_WORKSPACE%-*}; case $MUNI in tampere) BUCKET=trevaka-$ENV-terraform;; *) BUCKET=$MUNI-evaka-$ENV-terraform;; esac; export AWS_PROFILE=trevaka-$ENV; terraform output -no-color > versions.auto.tfvars && terraform plan -var-file=variables/$TFMUX_WORKSPACE-apps.tfvars -var=region=eu-west-1 -var=terraform_bucket=$BUCKET -var=utility_account_id=518207624130 -var=apps_version=current
